final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Collegi, luoghi di ricovero, case di pena, caserme, conventi',
    'Ospedali, cliniche, case di cura e assimilabili'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 1600
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 75
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the building located near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics) for a residential senior care facility. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.
The building must have an energy class of D or better, so classes A1 through D are accepted.

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area, so the total surface_area is set as a >= threshold. The capacity of 30 residents is not converted into an area filter. Energy class D or better and proximity to healthcare services are not in the reference columns and were ignored. Turin is a geographic location handled by the Location Agent, so it was not mapped to comune_code.
